common.disclaimer: ByeScribe helps consumers find instructions to cancel subscriptions. We never cancel services automatically.

home.heroSubtitle: Find the right guide, create a cancellation draft, and calculate your savings.
home.heroDisclaimer: You complete the cancellation with your provider.
home.searchPlaceholder: Which service do you want to cancel?
home.searchPrivacyHint: Search only by service name. Do not enter personal details.
home.searchPrivacyDetail: For example, customer ID or social security number.
home.valueStep1Desc: See how to cancel the service.
home.valueStep2Desc: Find notice periods and key terms.
home.howStep1Desc: Find the guide for your provider and check required details.
home.howStep2Desc: Use a cancellation draft if the provider requires a written message.
home.howStep3Desc: Complete the cancellation through the provider's official channel.
home.guidesEmpty: There are no published guides available here right now.
home.calcDesc: See your potential savings over 1 year and 5 years.
home.msgDesc: Create an editable text draft for email or letter. Everything stays in your browser.
home.summaCardTitle: Get full control of your recurring expenses with Summa
home.summaCardDescription: Discover unwanted subscriptions and track your spending directly on your phone.

search.pageDescription: Search objective cancellation guides for recurring subscriptions and memberships.
search.heading: Search for a cancellation guide
search.subtitle: Find cancellation steps, terms, and official contact paths for your subscriptions.
search.emptyPrompt: Type the name of the service you want to cancel in the search box above.
search.noResultsAdvice: Check your spelling or try a shorter name. Search only for the service name.
search.invalidQuery: Invalid search query. Query must be 1–100 characters and cannot contain control characters.
search.toolsCalcLink: Calculate your savings with the calculator

serviceGuide.demoNotice: Local demo – this information is sample data and not a verified service guide.
serviceGuide.staleNotice: This guide needs review. Terms and contact channels may have changed.
serviceGuide.providerExecution: Cancellation is completed directly with the provider.
serviceGuide.noSteps: No detailed steps published for this service yet.
serviceGuide.officialActionNotice: You will leave ByeScribe and complete cancellation on the provider's website.
serviceGuide.websiteNotice: No direct cancellation link available. Visit the provider's website for more details.
serviceGuide.toolsMessageDesc: Generate a ready text draft with {name} pre-filled.
serviceGuide.toolsCalcDesc: See how much you save over 1 year and 5 years by unsubscribing.
serviceGuide.disclaimerText: ByeScribe is an independent consumer guide and has no affiliation with the provider. Cancellation is always executed directly between you and the provider under your contract terms.

calculator.pageDescription: Calculate how much you can save per month, per year, and over five years by cancelling subscriptions.
calculator.heading: Subscription Savings Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Enter your subscription cost to see an estimate of your potential savings.
calculator.assumptionNotice: This calculation is an estimate based on the amount you provide.
calculator.costHint: Enter amount with a dot or comma as decimal separator (e.g. 149 or 149.90).
calculator.costError: Please enter a valid positive amount (up to 2 decimal places).
calculator.disclaimer: Calculation assumes a constant price and represents potential savings, not a guarantee.
calculator.nextStepsDesc: Ready to cancel? Search for the provider's cancellation guide or create a cancellation letter with our message tool.

messageGenerator.pageDescription: Create a safe, editable cancellation email or letter to end your subscription.
messageGenerator.heading: Create a Cancellation Message
messageGenerator.subtitle: Fill in the details below to generate an editable text draft to send to the provider.
messageGenerator.privacyNotice: What you type stays in your browser and is never sent to ByeScribe. Data is not saved when you leave.
messageGenerator.copySuccess: Text copied to clipboard. Paste it into your email client.
messageGenerator.copyManual: Select the text and copy manually (Ctrl+C / Cmd+C).
messageGenerator.copyIdle: The draft is not legally binding until you send it directly to the provider.
messageGenerator.nextStepsText1: ByeScribe does not send messages for you. You must send the text yourself via the provider's official channel (email, web form, or letter).
messageGenerator.nextStepsText2: Always save a copy of the sent message and the provider's written confirmation.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
